dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

publish.description: The tool's publish argument list, followed by each file under its dependency targets' outputs that a dependentTasksOutputFiles input of the target matches, none where the target states no such input

preview.description: The tool's own dry-run form, run in place of publish under a dry run, absent prints publish and runs nothing

credential.description: Environment variable holding the destination's credential, where it is unset or empty the run publishes nothing, names the variable, and succeeds

flag.description: Argument the tool takes the credential under, for a tool reading no variable itself

title: Publish
description: Delivers the files a project's packaging targets wrote to its registry or store through its tool's own publish command where the destination's credential is set, and names the missing variable where it is not; runs through nx release publish
